title: Sign in to Hourmere
instruction: Press the button to finish signing in.
note: This extra step keeps email security scanners, which open links to check them, from using up your sign-in link.
incomplete: This sign-in link is incomplete. Open the whole link from the email, or ask for a new one.
javascript: Signing in needs JavaScript. Turn it on for this page, then open the link from the email again.
